text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
WantsTo(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Compose(x) ::: x can compose.
WillCompose(x) ::: x will compose.
Premises:
(Likes(George, music) → WantsTo(George, compose)) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
(Access(George, program) → Compose(George)) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
(Compose(George) ∧ WantsTo(George, compose)) → WillCompose(George) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
(Likes(George, music) ∧ Access(George, program)) → WillCompose(George) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
